comment: fsd: QA gave 47 of 53 criteria a pass and none a fail. Of the six left: three (the existing loading tests, the cli integration tier and the e2e tier staying green) can only be seen in CI, which runs once the PR opens and must be green on the final head before ready is approved; the story in flight on an old-wording pin was driven to the end of its round in a harness repo with the pin's bytes and hash untouched; the restart from an old-wording branch file is covered by the shipped integration test, which passes (pin verbatim, hash equal). The orientations criterion, which the spec leaves to a person: every agent step in the shipped workflows has an orientation, none empty or a fallback line; ten are the owner's own earlier instructions word for word, seven are new one-sentence purpose statements (slice implement, review and merge; quick review; story implement and review; refinement clarify), and the describe step's line is the same as in the design record's quick.yaml; the two moved workflow hashes are explained by the new quick and story orientations
